passages.text: They may be too slight to matter or they may be worth the risk because the potential benefits are great
The sensibility that allows one to rediscover the unknown in the familiar is equally creative
Design is the application of intention, and you are only as intentional as you are informed
…the designer should see the import of the job and be alert to those to whom it is directed, to come to the right choices
The Japanese user often measures convenience by the amount of inconvenience they avoid causing to others
Design is the energetic acknowledgment of our own living world through the making of things and through communication
In the future, we will have more and more of whatever’s holding our attention right now
